newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 12.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Government plans to remove subsidies on agricultural infrastructure and housing from public funding.
-- Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka floats Asia investment consultative council idea.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) reform panel wants all low-interest housing loans to be channelled through Housing Loan Corp.
-- Prime Minsiter Ryutaro Hashimoto says Japan may send anti-terrorist commandos for training overseas.
-- 72 Percent of pollees in Okinawa and Japan as a whole want fewer U.S. troops in Okinawa.
-- Japanese Ambassador to Peru Morihisa Aoki to testify at Upper House on Tuesday.
